title: Implement Request Body Parser Middleware
description: This feature will allow yantraverse to parse JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, enabling developers to handle complex request data. It will provide a flexible and efficient way to process incoming requests. This middleware will be fully tested and documented to ensure production-readiness
acceptance: The request body parser middleware should correctly parse JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, and handle errors without crashing the application
reason: This feature is essential for building robust and scalable APIs, and its implementation will significantly improve the usability and functionality of the yantraverse framework
